kernel.name: swiglu
kernel.path: Fp16 direct. Exp sigmoid: Muls(-1)+Exp+Adds(1)+Reciprocal+Mul+Mul. Chunk=256. Workspace=half.

thought.title: swiglu Fp16 Direct Exp Silu Chunk256
thought.description: Eliminated Cast half↔float per chunk, replaced tanh-based sigmoid with Exp-based sigmoid, increased chunk size 64→256, switched workspace float→half
thought.reason:
CHANGE 1 [instruction/FP16Direct]: Removed AscendC::Cast(half→float) and Cast(float→half) per chunk. All 6 compute ops operate on half directly. Saves 2 Cast instructions per N_TILE=256 chunk.

CHANGE 2 [compute/ExpSigmoid]: Replaced tanh-based sigmoid (Muls(0.5)+Tanh+Adds(1)+Muls(0.5)) with Exp-based sigmoid (Muls(-1)+Exp+Adds(1)+Reciprocal). Both 4 ops for sigmoid but Exp/Reciprocal has better throughput on Ascend 910B.

CHANGE 3 [tiling/Chunk256]: SWI_GLU_CHUNK 64→256 (4x). Better utilization of 256-wide vector units, reducing loop overhead.

CHANGE 4 [memory/HalfWorkspace]: TBuf sizeof(T)=2 vs sizeof(float)=4. 5×256×2=2.5KB (half) vs 3×64×4=0.75KB (float). Larger chunk + half = manageable UB pressure.

runtime.dsl_before: Cast half→float. Tanh sigmoid: Muls(0.5)+Tanh+Adds(1)+Muls(0.5). Chunk=64. Workspace=float.
runtime.dsl_after: Fp16 direct. Exp sigmoid: Muls(-1)+Exp+Adds(1)+Reciprocal+Mul+Mul. Chunk=256. Workspace=half.
